fieldEvidence.news: 'No position may be opened, closed, or held within the restricted window'; scheduled releases run from 10 minutes before to 10 minutes after and the restriction is a hard breach.

notes: The 5% max loss trails peak equity and locks at starting balance after equity first reaches 5% profit; it does not reset after a reward.
Max Open Risk is 1% combined floating loss. Risk Per Trade Idea is 3% below $50K and 2% at $50K and above.
At least 7 profitable days of 0.25% or more are required in every rolling 30-day period.
Reward eligibility also requires consistency at or below 15%, a 3% safety cushion, and largest loss no greater than largest win.
News-window and weekend holding violations are hard breaches; the account is simulated and begins directly at Master.
